title: Senior Software Engineer (Frontend / Fullstack)
description:
Razorpay is India's leading fintech payments platform. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to build resilient, accessible payment checkout experiences and merchant dashboards.

Responsibilities:
- Build low-latency, resilient web UI using React, TypeScript, and modern state architectures.
- Scale frontend infrastructure serving millions of transactions across India.
- Work closely with backend teams, design, and product managers to launch innovative merchant features.

Requirements:
- 4+ years of hands-on experience in modern frontend and web technologies (React, TypeScript).
- Deep understanding of browser internals, web performance, and responsive interfaces.
- Experience with payment flows or high-traffic consumer systems is a plus.
requirements: Web performance & Core Web Vitals optimization

matchAnalysis.summary: Exceptional match! Your 4.5 years of React/TypeScript experience, LCP optimization background, and Bengaluru location strongly align with Razorpay engineering standards.
strengths: Direct alignment with 4+ years React and TypeScript tech stack
Demonstrated Core Web Vitals LCP optimization track record
gaps: Fintech payment protocols and security compliance experience can be highlighted during interview
interviewTalkingPoints: Discuss how you handled high throughput API requests and client-side error states
Highlight your App Router migration and 45% LCP load reduction

indiaRelevance.salaryFit: Within your expected bracket (₹28 - ₹35 LPA vs ₹32 - ₹42 LPA)
indiaRelevance.noticePeriodFit: 30 Days notice period is widely accepted at Razorpay

notes: Razorpay engineering bar is high on JS fundamentals and system design. Reaching out to recruiter on LinkedIn.

title: SDE 2 - Full Stack Engineer (Growth & AI)
description:
Swiggy is building consumer tech that powers convenience for millions of Indians every day.
We are looking for an SDE 2 to join the Growth engineering team.

Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain high-conversion customer touchpoints on web and app-web views.
- Integrate automated experiments, feature flags, and AI-driven personalization pipelines.
- Collaborate with backend engineers on Node.js/Java microservices.

Requirements:
- 3+ years experience with React, TypeScript, and Node.js.
- Strong problem-solving skills and experience with high-scale web platforms.

matchAnalysis.summary: High relevance for your experience with fullstack Node/React stacks and AI application experiments.
strengths: Strong alignment with target CTC bracket (₹28 - ₹36 LPA)
gaps: Familiarity with large-scale A/B testing infrastructure
interviewTalkingPoints: Explain how you integrated LLMs into existing web services
Walk through your microservice architecture with Node and PostgreSQL

indiaRelevance.salaryFit: Perfect match for ₹28 - ₹35 LPA expected CTC
